entries.jp: バーンシュタイン兵隊長
entries.en: Burnstein Captain

entries.jp: ランザック兵
entries.en: Ranzak Soldier

entries.jp: {FFEE}ウェーバーやランザック兵を守れ！{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}Protect Weber and the Ranzak soldiers!{FFF1}

entries.jp: あの程度の兵で、この俺様を止める気か！
entries.en: You think soldiers of that caliber can stop the likes{n}of me?!

entries.jp: 充分時間をかせいだな‥‥。{n}よし！　我々も退くぞ！
entries.en: We've bought enough time... Good! We're pulling{n}back too!

entries.jp: {v:0031}私がしんがりを務める！{n}皆は急ぎガラシールズへもどれ！
entries.en: {v:0031}I will bring up the rear! Everyone, hurry back{n}to Galashiels!

entries.jp: 後少しだけ、時間をかせぐか‥‥。
entries.en: I'll buy just a little more time...

entries.jp: {v:001E}すぐに敵の本隊が到着する！{n}時間はかけてられんぞ！
entries.en: {v:001E}The enemy's main force will be here soon! We have no{n}time to waste!

entries.jp: {v:001F}お前たちは！？
entries.en: {v:001F}You lot?!

entries.jp: {v:0020}助けに来たぜ、ウェーバー。
entries.en: {v:0020}We've come to help, Weber.

entries.jp: {v:0021}アタシ達にはルイセちゃんがいるから、{n}回り込めたんだ★
entries.en: {v:0021}We've got Luise-chan with us, so we could get{n}around them!

entries.jp: {v:0022}これは心強い援軍だ。{n}よし、いっきに敵を倒すぞ！
entries.en: {v:0022}Now these are reinforcements we can count on. Right,{n}let's finish the enemy in one stroke!

entries.jp: もう力が出ねぇ‥‥
entries.en: I ain't got any strength left...

entries.jp: 王都へは、何があっても‥‥
entries.en: They mustn't reach the royal capital... no{n}matter what...

entries.jp: 娘よ‥‥。{n}すまぬ‥‥。
entries.en: My daughter... Forgive me...

entries.jp: なんてザマだ‥‥
entries.en: What a sorry sight I am...

entries.jp: あ、あぁ‥‥。{n}ランザックの兵隊さん達が‥‥。
entries.en: A-ah... The soldiers of Ranzak...

entries.jp: 私の部下が‥‥、全滅だと！？
entries.en: My men... wiped out?!

entries.jp: く‥くそ‥‥！
entries.en: D-damn it...!

entries.jp: ウェーバー！
entries.en: Weber!

entries.jp: あ、あぁ‥‥。{n}助けられなかった‥‥。
entries.en: A-ah... We couldn't save them...

entries.jp: この俺が、こいつらごときに‥‥
entries.en: Me, beaten by the likes of them...

entries.jp: バカな‥‥
entries.en: Impossible...

entries.jp: ああ‥‥
entries.en: Ah...

entries.jp: ぐふっ！
entries.en: Guh!

entries.jp: 強い‥‥
entries.en: So strong...

entries.jp: そんな‥‥
entries.en: It can't be...

entries.jp: うう‥‥くそ‥‥
entries.en: Ugh... damn it...

entries.jp: 剣も魔法も極めた私が‥‥
entries.en: But I mastered both sword and magic...

entries.jp: {v:0062}また会ったな。{FFF9}{FFFB}{n}{v:0063}以前の約束通り、この場で正々堂々と決着を{n}付けるとしよう。
entries.en: {v:0062}We meet again.{FFF9}{FFFB} {v:0063}As we promised before, let us settle{n}this here, in honorable combat.

entries.jp: {v:0064}どうしても戦わなくちゃいけないの？
entries.en: {v:0064}Do we really have to fight?

entries.jp: {v:0065}それが戦場というものだ‥‥。{p}{v:0066}遠慮はいらぬ。{n}かかってこい！
entries.en: {v:0065}Such is the battlefield...{p}{v:0066}Do not hold back. Come at me!

entries.jp: {v:006D}どこで運命の歯車がずれてしまったのだろうな‥‥。{p}{v:006E}それとも、あの日出会ってしまった事が、そもそもの{n}間違いの始まりだったのか‥‥？{p}{v:006F}だがここで嘆いた所で、もはやあの時には戻れぬ！
entries.en: {v:006D}When did the gears of fate slip out of place...?{p}{v:006E}Or was our meeting that day the first mistake of all...?{p}{v:006F}But lamenting it here will never take us back to{n}that day!

entries.jp: {v:006A}因果なものだな。{n}戦争などなければ、{n}お前とはいい友になれたかもしれん‥‥。{p}{v:006B}だが、ここは戦場で、お前と私は敵同士だ‥‥。{FFF9}{FFFB}{n}{FC02}{v:006C}生き残りたければ‥‥私を越えて行け！
entries.en: {v:006A}What cruel fate. Were it not for this war, you and I{n}might have been good friends...{p}{v:006B}But this is a battlefield, and you and I are enemies...{FFF9}{FFFB}{n}{FC02}{v:006C}If you wish to survive... you must defeat me!

entries.jp: {v:0067}以前にも増して腕を上げたか‥‥。{FFF9}{FFFB}{n}{v:0068}出来ればもっと別の形で力を競ってみたかったな‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0067}Your skill has improved yet again...{FFF9}{FFFB} {v:0068}I wish we could{n}have tested our strength under{n}different circumstances...

entries.jp: {v:0069}そんな顔をするな！{n}私の‥‥私の剣先が鈍る！
entries.en: {v:0069}Do not look at me like that! My... my sword will falter!
{v:0033}Did we get Julian?

entries.jp: {v:0034}終わりよ、ジュリアン。
entries.en: {v:0034}It's over, Julian.

entries.jp: {v:0037}将軍！{n}助けに参りました！
entries.en: {v:0037}General! We have come to your aid!

entries.jp: {v:0039}我々が足止めをします！{n}今のうちにお戻りください！
entries.en: {v:0039}We will hold them off! Fall back while you can!
{v:003A}...F-forgive me...

entries.jp: {v:003B}ジュリアンが逃げちゃったよ！{n}どうするの？
entries.en: {v:003B}Julian got away! What do we do?

entries.jp: {v:003C}もう我々だけでも大丈夫だ。{n}追うかどうかは、君たちの判断に任せる。
entries.en: {v:003C}We can manage on our own now. I leave it to you{n}whether to pursue.

entries.jp: {v:003D}ああ、ジュリアンに逃げられちゃった‥‥。
entries.en: {v:003D}Oh, Julian got away...

entries.jp: {v:003E}今はこいつらを倒すほうが先決だろ？
entries.en: {v:003E}We've got to deal with these guys first, don't we?

entries.jp: {v:003F}ここは我々に任せて、君は奴を追うんだ。
entries.en: {v:003F}Leave this to us. You go after Julian.

entries.jp: {v:0040}俺たちも、こいつらを倒す。{n}お前はジュリアンを追え！
entries.en: {v:0040}We'll help finish these guys off. You go after Julian!

entries.jp: {v:0041}それじゃ、お願いね、みんな！
entries.en: {v:0041}We're counting on you, everyone!

entries.jp: {v:0042}うん。{n}任せて、お兄ちゃん！
entries.en: {v:0042}Okay. Leave it to us, Big Brother!

entries.jp: {v:0024}どうした、押されているぞ？
entries.en: {v:0024}What is the matter? They are pushing you back.

entries.jp: {v:0025}げっ！{n}ジュリアンだ‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0025}Gah! It's Julian...

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:0026}インペリアル・ナイトか‥‥。{n}相手にとって不足はない。
entries.en: ...{v:0026}An Imperial Knight... A worthy opponent.

entries.jp: {v:0027}ランザックのウェーバー将軍か。{n}それに、見た顔があるようだが？
entries.en: {v:0027}General Weber of Ranzak. And I see some familiar faces{n}with you?

entries.jp: {v:0028}なるほど。{n}ルイセのテレポートを使ったか。{p}{v:0029}だがお前たちが来たところで、どうなるかな？
entries.en: {v:0028}I see. You used Luise's Teleport.{p}{v:0029}But what difference will your arrival make?

entries.jp: {v:002A}一気に蹴散らすぞ！
entries.en: {v:002A}We shall sweep them aside in one stroke!
{v:002B}Yes, General!

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:002C}やるな。{FFF9}{FFFB}{n}{v:002D}これ以上被害を増やすのは得策ではないか‥‥。{p}{v:002E}総員、退却準備！{n}ガラシールズに戻って体勢を立て直す！
entries.en: ...{v:002C}Well fought.{FFF9}{FFFB} {v:002D}It would be unwise to suffer{n}further losses...{p}{v:002E}All troops, prepare to retreat! We will return to{n}Galashiels and regroup!
{v:002F}Yes, General!

entries.jp: このままでは不利だ。{n}ガラシールズに退き、態勢を立て直すぞ！
entries.en: We are at a disadvantage here. Fall back to Galashiels{n}and regroup!

entries.jp: {v:0030}逃がすか！{n}追撃するぞ！
entries.en: {v:0030}They won't get away! After them!
